packageRules.description: Group all Postiz-stack image updates into a single PR
Never propose Postgres major bumps: a major upgrade requires an in-place data migration (pg_upgrade / dump-restore), which a tag change cannot do. Patch/minor only; majors are handled manually.
Delay rancher/k3s image bumps (used only for crictl in the image-prune CronJob) until a tag has been out long enough to be past k3s pre-release/RC churn

Never bump Flux controller images on their own: gotk-components.yaml pins CRDs, RBAC and images together, so a lone image bump can outrun the CRDs and crash-loop the controller (notification-controller v1.10 needs v1 Provider/Alert CRDs). The fluxcd/flux2 bump regenerates the whole file and is the only supported path.
